scope: Identity-preserving flat rendering of original approved avatar native atlases, without changing proportions, facial features, hairstyle geometry, atlas rectangles or joint registration.
pixelProcessing: Native ImageGen output bytes copied unchanged. No procedural repaint, recoloring, background removal or vector replacements.

outputs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the supplied avatar sprite atlas. Keep exact 1536×1024 canvas, every subject, every part, every pixel silhouette, position, size, expression, direction, layer spacing and transparent cutout footprint. This is a production atlas already cropped by coordinate, so do not rearrange or resize anything. Convert ALL artwork to absolutely FLAT 2D cut-paper character art similar to friendly minimalist language-learning sprites. ZERO SHADOWS, ZERO shading, ZERO gradients, ZERO glow, ZERO highlights or glossy bevels, ZERO soft lighting, ZERO under-foot shadows, ZERO dark cloth folds/seams suggesting volume. Every material region must have one completely uniform solid color all the way to its antialiased edge. Skin columns left-to-right use solid #F8C5A4, #ECAE85, #CC8E61, #BA8058, #A65F31, #70442E. Keep smile/eyebrows/eye shapes with single flat dark colors, keep nose a small flat simple shape. Clothes keep their current magenta/teal/navy/orange/ivory color identities using consistent solid fills. Hair must be flat silhouette, accessories flat color shapes. Do not add outlines around silhouettes. Keep tiny graphic details/buttons/pockets as flat intentional graphic shapes, no dimensional edge/rim shadows. Transparent background with alpha, no background glow or color wash. Do not add text, labels, grid or new objects.
